g.title: aeris10_hardware_interconnection
g.text: AERIS-10 - Hardware interconnection diagram (inter-board connectors and cables)
Drawing ID: SYS-02 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: SOURCE-DERIVED; cables themselves are not in any CAD file (lengths, gauge, coax type UNKNOWN)

Source: RADAR_Main_Board.sch (X*, J*, JP*, SV1 nets), PowerBoard.sch (X1..X35, SV1), Clocks_Freq_Synth_board.sch/.brd (J1..J13, JP1, JP2, X10..X15 + silkscreen), RF_PA.sch/.brd (J1, J2, X2, X3, '22V'), main.h (STM32 pins), docs/SYSTEM/BLOCK_DIAGRAM.md section 2
Legend: solid = both ends in CAD | dashed = one end off-board (no CAD) | red = conflict / missing hardware | cable IDs CBL-xx are PROPOSED (see interconnection_table.md)

g.title: PWR
g.text: X1 AK300/2 input; X2..X35 Molex 22-23-2021; SV1 MA10-2

g.title: MAIN
g.text: JP1 2x6, JP13 2x7; J1,J18,J20 SMA; J19,J21 CJT; JP20 1x2
J22,J23 LO SMA; J24..J55 32x SMA; X3,X38..X52 Molex 3-pin; X_1..X_16 Molex 2-pin

g.title: PWR->MAIN
g.text: X12->X9 +3V3_AN (Main also has X56 on the same net: 2nd source UNVERIFIED) | X10->X17 +1V8_CLOCK
X30->X12 +3V3_VDD_SW | X23->X1 +3V4 (Main X54 same net) | X24->X11 -3V4 (Main X22 same net)

g.title: SYN
g.text: JP1 2x6, JP2 2x7; J1,J2,J5..J13 SMA; J3,J4 CJT; X10..X15 Molex 2-pin

g.title: PWR->SYN
g.text: X35->X10 +3V3_XO (via L9) | X11->X11 +3V3_CLOCK (via L10) | X10->X12 +1V8_CLOCK (via L11)
NOTE: Power X10 (+1V8_CLOCK) is the only +1V8_CLOCK output but is needed by Main X17 AND Synth X12 -> splitting UNRESOLVED

g.title: MAIN->PWR
g.text: CBL-21: SV1 MA10-2 -> SV1 MA10-2, 20-way ribbon (3.3 V CMOS enables):
12,14,16,18,20 GND (pin map identical on both boards)

g.title: MAIN->SYN
g.text: CBL-28: JP1 PINHD-2X6 -> JP1 PINHD-2X6, 12-way (SPI4 3.3 V + GPIO):

g.title: MAIN->SYN
g.text: CBL-29: JP13 PINHD-2X7 -> JP2 PINHD-2X7, 14-way (SPI4 3.3 V + GPIO):
9 ADF4382_RX_CS(PG10) 10 ADF4382_RX_CE(PG9) 11 ADF4382_RX_DELSTR(PG8) 12 ADF4382_RX_DELADJ(PG7) 13 ADF4382_RX_LKDET(PG6) 14 GND

g.title: PA
g.text: RF PA Board (x16 per README; 1 in CAD)
J1 SMA RFIN, J2 SMA RFOUT, X2 Molex 2-pin VG, X3 Molex 3-pin, '22V' AK300/2

g.title: MAIN->PA
g.text: RF_SW_n RFOUT1/RFOUT2 -> J(2n+22)/J(2n+23) -> PA J1 RFIN / PA J2 RFOUT
element map: SW1 J27/J26, SW2 J29/J28, SW3 J25/J24, SW4 J31/J30, SW5 J35/J34, SW6 J37/J36, SW7 J33/J32, SW8 J39/J38,
WHICH of the two SMAs feeds PA RFIN and where PA RFOUT returns: UNVERIFIED (no silk, no doc)

g.title: MAIN->PA
g.text: CBL-56..CBL-71 (x16) Molex 22-23-2021 2-wire: X_1..X_16 (VG_n, GND) -> PA X2 (VG, GND), analogue gate bias -4..-1.2 V (xlsx)

g.title: MAIN->HOST
g.text: CBL-90: X53 MINI-USB [2 D- (PA11), 3 D+ (PA12), 4 ID (PA10), 5 GND] (USB 2.0 full-speed, CDC per firmware)

g.title: MAIN->DBG
g.text: JP2 PINHD-1X6 [1 +3V3, 2 SWCLK, 3 GND, 4 SWDIO, 5 NRST, 6 SWO] (ARM SWD)

g.title: MAIN->GPS
g.text: JP8 PINHD-1X4 [1 +3V3, 2 STM32_TX5 (PC12), 3 STM32_RX5 (PD2), 4 GND] (UART 3.3 V, 9600 Bd per firmware)

g.title: MAIN->IMU
g.text: JP7 PINHD-1X8 [2 +3V3, 3 GND, 4 STM32_SCL3 (PA8), 5 STM32_SDA3 (PC9), 6 MAG_DRDY (PC6), 7 ACC_INT (PC7), 8 GYR_INT (PC8)]
JP18 PINHD-1X4 [1 SDA3, 2 SCL3, 3 GND, 4 +3V3] (I2C 3.3 V)

g.title: MAIN->TEMP
g.text: JP5, JP6, JP11, JP12, JP14, JP15, JP16, JP19 PINHD-1X3 [1 +3V3_AN4_F, 2 analogue, 3 GND] (TMP37 analogue, 8 ch -> ADS7830)

g.title: MAIN->STEP
g.text: JP9 PINHD-1X4 [1 GND, 2 STEPPER_CW+ (PD4), 3 GND, 4 STEPPER_CLK+ (PD5)] (3.3 V step/dir)

g.title: MAIN->FAN
g.text: JP4 PINHD-1X3 [1 EN/DIS_COOLING (PD7), 3 GND] (3.3 V relay control)

g.title: MAIN->PASW
g.text: JP10 PINHD-1X3 [1 EN/DIS_RFPA_VDD (PD6), 3 GND] -> PA drain switch (device NOT IN CAD)

g.title: SYN->MAIN
g.text: Clock coax (50 ohm SMA 142-0731-211, type/length UNKNOWN):
CBL-30: J7 'FPGA SYS. CLOCK' (AD9523_OUT6+, 100 MHz LVCMOS) -> J1 FPGA_SYS_CLOCK -> U42 IO_L13P_T2_MRCC_15
CBL-31: J5 'DAC' (OUT10, 120 MHz LVCMOS) -> J20 DAC_CLOCK -> U3 CLOCK
CBL-32: J6 'FPGA=DAC' (OUT11, 120 MHz LVCMOS) -> J18 FPGA_DAC_CLOCK -> U42 IO_L12N_T1_MRCC_15
CBL-33: J8 'TEST' (OUT7, 20 MHz LVCMOS) -> JP20 1x2 FPGA_CLOCK_TEST (SMA-to-header adapter: UNVERIFIED)

g.title: SYN->MAIN
g.text: Differential clock (CJT-T-P-HH-ST-TH1 twinax, pins 1 P / 2 N):
CBL-34: J3 'ADC' (AD9523_OUT4_P/N, 400 MHz LVDS) -> J21 (N$2_P/N) -> C1/C2 -> U1 CLK+/CLK-
CBL-35: J4 'FPGA=ADC' (AD9523_OUT5_P/N, 400 MHz LVDS) -> J19 FPGA_ADC_CLOCK_P/N -> U42 IO_L13P/N_T2_MRCC_14 (unused by RTL)

g.title: SYN->MAIN
g.text: LO coax (SMA, 10.5 GHz / 10.38 GHz per adf4382a_manager.h):
(J1 AUX. LO TX, J12, J2/J9 MUXOUT, J13 PLL_OUT: no Main-Board counterpart - test/aux)

g.title: PA->MAIN
g.text: CBL-72..CBL-87 (x16) Molex 22-23-2031 3-wire: PA X3 [1 VD, 2 VIN_M, 3 GND] -> Main X3/X38..X52 [S: GND, INA IN+, INA IN-]
shunt sense across R10 5 mR (WSL2816); Main side: X3->U11, X38->U73 ... (pin-to-pin order UNVERIFIED: EAGLE pads all 'S')
PA board instance -> Main connector assignment: NOT DOCUMENTED

g.title: V22
g.text: NOT IN ANY CAD (xlsx row 59: 22 V / 2 A x16)

g.title: V22->PA
g.text: CBL-88 (x16): -> '22V' AK300/2 [KL1 VD, KL2 GND], DC power 22 V (xlsx)

g.title: VINSRC->PWR
g.text: CBL-00: -> X1 AK300/2 [KL1 VIN, KL2 GND] (DC power, 12-17 V)
